Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, v As Variant
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c0.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        ws.ClearArrows
    Case 1
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c1.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        ws.ClearCircles
    Case 2
        ws.Protect
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c2.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        ws.ClearArrows
    Case 3
        ws.Protect
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c3.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        ws.ClearCircles
    Case 4
        ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=B1"
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c4.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        ws.ClearArrows
    Case 5
        ws.Range("A1").Validation.Add xlValidateWholeNumber, xlValidAlertStop, xlBetween, "1", "5"
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 9
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\c5.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        ws.ClearCircles
    End Select
    Tried = TypeName(v) & " " & ws.Shapes.Count & " " & wb.Saved
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 5
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
